newsitem.title: GERMANY: MG says not to buy stake in AGIV.
newsitem.headline: MG says not to buy stake in AGIV.

text.p: Germany's Metallgesellschaft AG said on Thursday it has decided not to buy a 49.99 percent stake in German industrial holding company AGIV.
MG's announcement came after AGIV said on Wednesday that it had decided to halt the due-dilligence process associated with the transaction of the 49.99 percent stake held in the group by BHF Bank.

MG had said on Wednesday that it and BHF had wanted to carry out the AGIV sale. But the Frankfurt-based group said on Thursday that the deal was called off due to the outcome of the due-dilligence process thus far.
The two companies have said the due-dilligence process was halted due to negative press reports.
